rule: C (Paul, 7 Oct 2026): LEAD when the song is on one of the artist's own Spotify releases (title match, own-releases-2026-10-07.json) or the artist is first-listed on the track (kworb: no '*'); FEATURED otherwise; app/data/roleOverrides.json overrides three to featured; billing decides only where Spotify has no track for the artist. The role is not typed here: scripts/roles/rule-c-lib.mjs derives it.

fields.spotifyId: the Spotify track the release is (inventory match on the artist's kworb page)
fields.spotifyTitle: that track's title, as kworb / Spotify print it — what Rule C matches against the artist's own releases
fields.firstListed: kworb song page shows no '*' against the track for this artist (read 2–6 Oct 2026 pages)
fields.billing: the release billing as stored (Burna Boy: the ledger credit; board: the register row a fallback was decided by)
fields.fallbackRole: no Spotify track and no stored billing: the sweep's filing, kept
fields.coLeadWith: Burna Boy's co-leads only: the other acts named in the tag, site spelling
fields.note: why a row has no Spotify track
fields.titleCollision: a song on the artist's own releases shares this release's title but is a DIFFERENT record: part 1 (own release) is skipped for this row, so the first-listed test decides. Why, with the other record's track ids
